title: Network Level (II) – Routing and Congestion
subtopics: routing algorithm requirements: correct, simple, robust, optimal, fast-converging

definitions.definition: The process of selecting paths in a network along which to send packets
Routing Information Protocol – distance-vector routing protocol using hop count
Open Shortest Path First – link-state routing protocol using Dijkstra's algorithm
Border Gateway Protocol – path-vector routing protocol for inter-AS routing
A collection of IP networks under a single administrative policy
State where network demand exceeds available capacity

algorithms.name: Bellman-Ford
algorithms.description: Distance-vector algorithm used in RIP; computes shortest paths

algorithms.name: Dijkstra
algorithms.description: Link-state algorithm used in OSPF; finds shortest path tree from one source

learning_objectives: Explain routing algorithm requirements and operation
Explain BGP role in inter-domain routing
Describe network congestion causes and control mechanisms
